english.title: Open container of export goods loaded within the UK without authority
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without the authority of the proper officer, were concerned in the opening of a container in which goods, namely **(..SPECIFY THE GOODS..), were

(A)_[loaded as mentioned in section 67(1) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979]_
(B)_[retained as mentioned in section 67(1) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979]_
(C)_[brought to a customs and excise station at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..) for exportation by land]_

being

(D)_[goods from warehouse]_
(E)_[transit goods]_
(F)_[goods chargeable with a duty which had not been paid]_
(G)_[drawback goods]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 67(4) and (5) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.
